item.description: Al comparar sus hallazgos, los Boys comprenden que algo sigue sin encajar. Leche Materna exige explicaciones a Butcher mientras Hughie avanza con Monkey y nuevas noticias agravan la desconfianza dentro del grupo.

en.description: Comparing their findings, the Boys realise that something is still wrong. Mother's Milk demands answers from Butcher as Hughie makes progress with Monkey and fresh news deepens distrust within the group.
